Sonatina vendors Google's standalone Subband Codec library (google/libsbc)
under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE in this directory).

Upstream repository:
  https://github.com/google/libsbc

Retained / minimally adapted files:
- include/sbc.h   (added SONATINA_KERNEL include path to portable.h and
                   SBC_ALIGNAS_INT alignment macro for MSVC/WDK)
- src/bits.h      (use portable.h + UINT_MAX fallback under SONATINA_KERNEL)
- src/bits.c      (verbatim)
- src/sbc.c       (use portable.h memset/memcpy under SONATINA_KERNEL)
